items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: On the Victor date... Leo. Leo Eddie. Right. Because they made that right after they come back from Mobile.

ctx.x: The others were all the same? They only made... I mean the others were all the same, the drummer and all. Yeah. No, no, no, with the...

On the Victor date. No, with the Victor date, Leo. Leo Eddie. Right. Because they made that right after they come back from Mobile. They made the Victor date first and then they made the OK. That's the one with the Golden Leaf Strut and Crying For Me. They made on that.
Did you ever play play play night on any records?
